exception.rationale: Exact bytes match the previously assessed exception. It explicitly overrides already-terminal cancellation replay, the completed-result ledger promise and the TH-015 ledger control. Terminal cancellation returns E_NOT_FOUND; cancellation after ID reuse with an old generation returns E_STALE. Lost-response SUBMIT retries can create new work; controllers must attribute output using session, owner, request ID and generation. Unchanged implementation/tests and current evidence preserve AC-005/007/020/021. Exactly-once delivery is not established.
